name: Roadmap A — Creative-First
source: Human-selected Roadmap A 2026-10-28; Work Tree v1.0 Library baseline; EF-01 dual-executor update 2026-10-28
plan_note: Preserves six selected stages and A01–A18 planning IDs; expanded package names/scope are canonical planning articulation, not tasks executed. Supersession 2026-10-28: EF02 multi-action concurrent implementation approved; historical status notes below remain dated snapshots. Human approved three EF01/EF02 non-gating enhancement WorkItems on 2026-10-28; WBS baseline, phase milestones and A01-A18 dependencies unchanged. Human 2026-10-29 approved A03/A04 v1.1 upgrade and A05 C03+C06 implementation (docs/governance/HUMAN_DECISION_2026-10-29_CREATIVE_V1_1_A05.md); A06 E01/M1 not proven.

engineering_flow.ef01: Selective clone with manual Codex/Antigravity model/effort selection, optional recommendation, targeted verify, repair and honest token observations
engineering_flow.ef02: EF02 Multi-Action v1 (Human approved): concurrent ingress, batched DAG scheduling, at least 2 truly overlapping EF01 processes on Windows in independent worktrees; identity/claim, per-action+aggregate results, authorized repair; optional native/Chat Wake proof separate.

work_items.title: Optional Direct Git + measured pytest-xdist 12-worker profile

packages.title: Project Bootstrap
packages.deliverable: Independent repository skeleton, conventions, targeted tests and isolation
packages.acceptance: Clean local CLI/test foundation; compatible with separately approved selective AIOS code adoption

packages.title: Contracts & Product Adapters
packages.deliverable: Typed contracts, evidence identity, mock product/provider adapters
packages.acceptance: Schemas validate valid/invalid data; mock produces traceable output

packages.title: Freeform Brief & Creative Reasoner
packages.deliverable: Editable content briefs and creative concept generation
packages.acceptance: Concept generation without required SKU, quota or mandatory storyboard
packages.upgrade_scope: Backwards-compatible Creative/Media readiness; optional live model adapter configured only when separately authorized

packages.title: Media Sources & Local Operations
packages.deliverable: Local asset job/runner and media adapter
packages.acceptance: One mock or selected asset run with traceable logs; unknown remains unknown
packages.upgrade_scope: Backwards-compatible Creative/Media readiness; optional live model adapter configured only when separately authorized

packages.title: Script, Scene & Video Render
packages.acceptance: Playable MP4 with manifest and diagnostics
packages.implementation_choice: Composition IR + local FFmpeg/ffprobe, no forced storyboard/CTA

packages.title: Offline Creative E2E
packages.acceptance: Usable video with traceable generation; no publish/account proof required

packages.title: Channel Capability Foundation
packages.acceptance: Permission UNKNOWN separate from allowed; no shared AIOS accounts

packages.title: Assisted Distribution & Receipts
packages.deliverable: Export package, assisted posting path, publication record
packages.acceptance: SUBMITTED, confirmed and PUBLIC states distinct; no fictional provider receipt

packages.title: Audience Growth Observation
packages.acceptance: Account-specific metrics imported when real; offline PARTIAL is honest

packages.title: Opportunity & Audience Intelligence
packages.deliverable: Trend, audience and opportunity hypotheses into Creative
packages.acceptance: Snapshot distinguished from trend; content-only ideas possible

packages.title: Audience Learning Registry
packages.acceptance: Metric window/source/version retained; correlation not asserted as causation

packages.title: Product Evidence Foundation
packages.acceptance: Seller claims, verified facts and UNKNOWN rights separate

packages.title: Affiliate Release Evidence
packages.deliverable: Claim/rights and account×link eligibility release pack
packages.acceptance: Unknown eligibility blocks only actual commercial placement, not creative production

packages.title: Affiliate Commerce E2E
packages.deliverable: Affiliate content loop with attribution status

packages.title: Operational Cost & Idempotency
packages.deliverable: Cost ledger, dedupe/reconciliation and operational status
packages.acceptance: Estimated vs charged separate; retry does not blindly duplicate side effects

packages.title: Settlement & Commercial Evidence
packages.acceptance: Order created/refunded/settled separated; attribution scope explicit

packages.title: Creative & Channel Scaling Extensions
packages.deliverable: Variants, feedback, expanded distribution and dashboards
packages.acceptance: No mandatory scale; external posting only with actual access and authorization

packages.title: Portfolio & Own Brand Decision
packages.deliverable: Decision support for scale and own-brand option
packages.acceptance: Human controls inventory, capital and authorization; no automatic commitment

milestones.M0: A01 and A02 planning scope plus EF01 core implemented with independent dual-executor capability; EF02 remote is tracked separately as M0-R rather than a gate for Creative Factory.
milestones.M0-R: EF02 multi-action remote ingress and GitHub feedback demonstrated on Windows: at least two overlapping independent EF01 executor processes in one batch, DAG results, dedup claims, and readable aggregate evidence. True proactive Chat Wake/native continuation optional and separately evidenced.
milestones.M1: E01 playable offline video and artifact provenance.
milestones.M2: Assisted distribution package and truthful status receipts.
milestones.M3: Audience measurement/insight prototypes, not fabricated live outcomes.
milestones.M4: Audience learning and affiliate release/E2E evidence recorded at actual entitlement level.
milestones.M5: Scoped costs, attribution and settled economics evidence where available.
milestones.M6: Optional scaling and own-brand decision support; Human retains final authority.
